controles.affirmation: Faiblesses materielles de controle interne : controles et procedures juges non efficaces au 3 juillet 2026, remediation en cours sans date
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026, Item 4 : "Based on such evaluation, our CEO and CFO concluded that our disclosure controls and procedures were not effective as of the end of such period because of the material weaknesses in internal controls previously reported in our 2025 Form 10-K." ; "We, with the oversight of the Audit Committee, continue to make progress on our remediation plans for the material weaknesses identified in prior years." ; "The material weaknesses will not be considered remediated until the applicable remedial controls operate for a sufficient period of time and management has concluded, through testing, that these controls are operating effectively." Il s'agit d'une deficience de controle interne declaree par la societe, non d'une procedure judiciaire ou reglementaire : l'ATT ne la qualifie pas comme telle.

controles.affirmation: Rachats d'actions : aucun au T2 2026 contre 316,9 M$ au T2 2025 ; 677,4 M$ rachetes sur le premier semestre 2026
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026 : "There were no stock repurchases during the second quarter of 2026. During the first two quarters of 2026, we repurchased approximately 4.7 million shares of common stock in open market purchases at an average price of $67.59 per share for a total of $316.9 million, excluding related excise taxes. During the second quarter and the first two quarters of 2025, we repurchased approximately 0.7 million and 9.7 million shares of common stock in open market purchases at an average price of $71.43 and $70.04 per share for a total of $50.0 million and $677.4 million, excluding related excise taxes."
controles.correction_proposee: Les deux montants sont intervertis. 316,9 M$ est le total du PREMIER SEMESTRE 2026 ; 677,4 M$ est le total du premier semestre 2025 ; le T2 2025 s'etablit a 50,0 M$. Ecrire : "aucun rachat au T2 2026, contre 50,0 M$ au T2 2025 ; sur le premier semestre 2026, 316,9 M$ ont ete rachetes, integralement au premier trimestre, contre 677,4 M$ au premier semestre 2025".

controles.affirmation: La marge operationnelle GAAP progresse de 13,6 % a 14,6 % du chiffre d'affaires du T2 2025 au T2 2026
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026, tableau MD&A : "Operating income 132.0 / 127.8" ; "Operating income as a % of revenue 13.6% / 14.6%", la premiere colonne etant le T2 2026 et la seconde le T2 2025. Le MD&A confirme le sens : "Operating income as a percentage of revenue decreased for the second quarter due to higher operating expenses."
controles.correction_proposee: Le sens est inverse : la marge operationnelle GAAP RECULE de 14,6 % au T2 2025 a 13,6 % au T2 2026. Elle ne progresse que sur le semestre (13,1 % -> 14,4 %). A noter que la depreciation de 562 M$ est classee par Trimble en resultat NON operationnel : elle n'affecte donc pas cette marge, contrairement a ce que l'enchainement du texte laisse croire.

controles.affirmation: Revenus recurrents annualises (ARR) en hausse de 11,9 % sur un an
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026 : "annualized recurring revenue ('ARR') of $2.5 billion, which represents growth of 14% year-over-year at the end of the second quarter of 2026. Excluding the impact of foreign currency, acquisitions, and divestitures, organic ARR growth was 12%." Tableau MD&A : "Annualized Recurring Revenue $2,509.0 / $2,210.4 / $298.6 / 14%" (soit +13,5 % exactement).
controles.correction_proposee: Remplacer 11,9 % par +13,5 % (arrondi a 14 % par la societe), ou par +12 % si l'on veut la croissance organique. Le chiffre de 11,9 % ne figure dans aucune source.

controles.affirmation: Croissance organique du chiffre d'affaires a deux chiffres sur les trois segments
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026, tableaux de reconciliation par segment pour le deuxieme trimestre : AECO "Organic growth 9%" ; Field Systems "Organic growth 12%" ; T&L "Organic growth 5%".
controles.correction_proposee: Un seul segment sur trois affiche une croissance organique a deux chiffres au T2 2026 (Field Systems, +12 %). AECO est a +9 % et T&L a +5 %. Ecrire : "croissance organique de +12 % pour Field Systems, +9 % pour AECO et +5 % pour T&L".

controles.affirmation: La marge operationnelle du segment T&L a recule sur un an malgre la croissance du chiffre d'affaires
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026, tableau segments : T&L "Operating income % 24.0%" au T2 2026 contre "21.6%" au T2 2025. MD&A T&L : "Operating income and operating income as a percentage of revenue increased for the second quarter and first two quarters primarily due to organic revenue growth and gross margin expansion."
controles.correction_proposee: La marge operationnelle de T&L a AUGMENTE, de 21,6 % a 24,0 % (+2,4 points). Supprimer cette affirmation : elle est contredite mot pour mot par le document. L'argument du bloc peut se tenir sans elle, en s'appuyant uniquement sur le fait que la depreciation de 562 M$ a frappe ce seul segment.

controles.affirmation: Depreciation de survaleur de 562,0 M$ sur le segment T&L au T2 2026 ; perte nette de 471,7 M$ contre +89,2 M$ ; BPA dilue -2,02 $ contre +0,37 $ ; BPA non-GAAP 0,86 $ contre 0,71 $
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026 : "we performed an interim assessment of our goodwill and other long-lived assets and recorded a goodwill impairment of $562.0 million in our T&L reporting unit. The impairment amount represents the excess of the carrying value of the T&L reporting unit over its fair value" ; compte de resultat "Net (loss) income $(471.7) / $89.2" ; "Diluted (loss) earnings per share $(2.02) / $0.37" ; "Non-GAAP diluted earnings per share $0.86 / $0.71".
controles.correction_proposee: Precision utile : le document designe comme evenement declencheur "a sustained decline in market capitalization and stock price", l'incertitude macroeconomique et les multiples de marche n'etant que ce que ce recul refletait. L'ATT omet le declencheur principal (la chute durable de la capitalisation boursiere).

controles.affirmation: Charges de restructuration de 12,6 M$ au T2 2026 contre 4,0 M$, 15,5 M$ contre 8,5 M$ sur six mois, et 19,3 / 15,9 / 45,6 M$ sur les exercices 2025 / 2024 / 2023
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026, compte de resultat : "Restructuring 12.6 4.0 15.5 8.5". 10-K FY2025, compte de resultat pluriannuel : "Restructuring 19.3 15.9 45.6".

controles.affirmation: T&L pese 14 % du chiffre d'affaires au T2 2026, contre 40 % pour AECO et 46 % pour Field Systems
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026, tableau segments T2 2026 : AECO 388,5 M$, Field Systems 442,5 M$, T&L 141,0 M$ sur un total de 972,0 M$, soit 40,0 %, 45,5 % et 14,5 %. Revenu T&L 141,0 M$ contre 132,7 M$ (+6 %).

controles.affirmation: Coentreprise AGCO : cession d'avril 2024 contre 1,9 Md$ et 15 % de PTx Trimble ; participation valorisee 216,8 M$ fin 2025 contre 222,3 M$ fin 2024 et 275,6 M$ de juste valeur initiale ; risques listes au 10-K
controles.verbatim_source: 10-K FY2025 : "On April 1, 2024, we completed the sale and contribution of our Ag business to AGCO in exchange for $1.9 billion of cash proceeds and an equity ownership interest in PTx Trimble, a joint venture... with a fair value of $275.6 million... we own 15% of PTx Trimble." ; "Of the total carrying amount of equity method investments, our 15% investment in PTx Trimble was $216.8 million and $222.3 million at the end of 2025 and 2024." ; Item 1A : "(i) we may fail to realize the anticipated benefits of our non-controlling stake in the JV, (ii) the benefits from the various agreements entered into concurrently with forming the JV (including long-term supply agreements) will be dependent upon the JV's ability to successfully develop, market and distribute products... (iv) the development of technology synergies will depend on the level of research and development spending and the success of future innovation."
controles.correction_proposee: Donnee plus recente disponible et non utilisee : le 10-Q T2 2026 indique "our 15% investment in PTx Trimble was $212.1 million and $216.8 million at the end of the second quarter of 2026 and end of 2025". La baisse continue et l'ATT pourrait citer 212,1 M$.

controles.affirmation: Emprunt de 200 M$ sur la ligne de credit renouvelable au T2 2026 pour financer Document Crunch ; nouveau programme de rachat de 1,0 Md$ approuve le 10 aout 2026
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026 : "During the second quarter of 2026, we borrowed $200.0 million from the 2025 Credit Facility to finance the acquisition of Document Crunch." 8-K du 12 aout 2026 : "On August 10, 2026, the Board of Directors authorized the repurchase of up to $1.0 billion in shares of the Company's common stock... replaces the prior authorization of up to $1.0 billion, of which $608.2 million was remaining as of the end of the second quarter of 2026."
